title: US monetary base, M2 and total reserves, monthly (1959-2026), billions of dollars
source: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (H.3 Aggregate Reserves of Depository Institutions and the Monetary Base; H.6 Money Stock Measures), via FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
series: BOGMBASE (monetary base: currency in circulation plus reserve balances, not seasonally adjusted); M2NS (M2, not seasonally adjusted); M2SL (M2, seasonally adjusted); TOTRESNS (total reserves of depository institutions, not seasonally adjusted)
license: Works of the US government (Federal Reserve Board, H.3 and H.6). FRED's terms ask users to 'cite the data source and acknowledge that you obtained the data from FRED' (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/legal/; quoted in fred_prices_monthly.json).
notes: Downloaded 2026-10-14 (latest month August 2026). Dates are the first day of the month; values are monthly averages. The money stock is revised (benchmarks and seasonal factors), so later downloads can differ slightly; Chapter 4 approximates currency held outside banks by BOGMBASE - TOTRESNS (total reserves include vault cash used to satisfy reserve requirements); see checks/check_ch04.py.
